input: I want to increase the navigabiltiy and seo and searchability and organization of the ghp website further
follow_up_inputs: fix the gitops and research programme failures too
task: Pages site: make guides, posts and collection pages searchable; make BreadcrumbList match the visible trail

errors.what: First search-index version listed every templated 'vs' guide, so 'jobber' returned 86 near-identical rows; then an exact-title dedupe missed near-duplicate titles.
errors.fix: Leave out vs pages that comparisonProductGroups already gathers into compare/<product>/.

errors.what: The throwaway audit's description regex stopped at apostrophes and reported 40 duplicate and 1 missing description that were not real.
errors.fix: Checked the pages by hand; the report says so.

errors.what: Edited docs/posts (a build input) while the full suite ran, which made the cache-name determinism test compare two different trees.
errors.fix: Re-ran that test alone after the tree settled.

doc_friction.issue: injectChrome's comment and the test 'breadcrumbs go on entry pages only' kept a decision ('a deep page is not a level of the site') that the later site-nav.mjs visible 4-level trail contradicted; nothing linked the two.

deviations.why: Replaced an existing test pinning the entry-only breadcrumb decision; the visible trail it was premised on no longer holds.

goal: SEO and distribution: site search and structured data for the Pages site
notes: Audit of 4,231 indexable pages: no BreadcrumbList 1,756 -> 82; search index gained 1,451 guides, 72 posts, 89 collection pages (453 -> 679 KB gzipped). check.mjs: publishable, 4238 pages, no dead links. Headless Chromium on the built hub: guide, compare and post results render and link correctly, no page errors. Full platform/pages suite (node --test "*.test.mjs"): 1237 pass, 6 fail. 5 were readme-live-link.test.mjs failing on main since P047 (7a7a6a74) moved BASE to /oss-monorepo/ while the already-linked regex still matched only monorepo-projects/; fixed here (8/8 pass, --check exits 0). 1 was 'an identical build produces an identical cache name', caused by this session adding a docs/posts file between the suite's two builds; re-run alone on a quiet tree: pass. Two sequential CLI builds diffed identical. Later: main fixed the same readme-live-link bug independently (#9976); on merging main this PR took main's version, so this PR no longer changes that file. CI on the first head also failed gitops (2 tests: unregenerated front-door mirror shard count, and the pinned nginx location count 12 vs 14 after .tsv/.whl blocks); both red on main too, reproduced on an origin/main worktree, a 4-line patch makes all 84 pass; posted on the PR rather than widening it. CI on head 3b7c06c failed Portfolio Pages `build`: check.mjs rejected research/civ-levers/app/index.html (from main, #9976) for a 250-char description and 200-char og/twitter descriptions over the 160 budget, which would block every Pages build of main. Shortened both from the page's own claims; rebuilt; check.mjs: publishable, 4274 pages, no dead links. Owner follow-up: fix gitops and the research programme check too. gitops: main had already fixed both stale pins (#9962), which this branch carries since its last main merge; test_manifests.py 84 passed here. Running front-door-tools.mjs --write also wrote 42 MB of untracked generated mirror files (gitops/prod/front-door-tools/), deleted, not committed. Programme check: none of the three projects fits an existing programme (lowcomm-training, sim2real-inference, verifiable-training-mechanisms), and legacy_projects.txt is defined as 'on main before the bar', which they were not, so each gets programme 'none' with a why_standalone (two are one-run follow-ups to pre-programme projects, one is a literature synthesis). programme_check.py: ok; research/_homepage/build.py: ok; unittest test_programme_check test_pick_track: 13 OK. Full platform/pages suite on the merged tree: 1244 pass, 0 fail. Later still: the PR went conflicted because main fixed the same files independently (programme 'none' + why_standalone on all three projects, and shorter civ-levers descriptions). Took main's versions; this PR no longer changes anything under research/. After that merge: programme_check ok, its unit tests OK, gitops test_manifests 84 passed.

corrections.what: The research and civ-levers fixes this session pushed were superseded by equivalent fixes on main and dropped in the merge.
